violated_contract: An input validator for an external taxonomy must accept every identifier the authoritative taxonomy publishes; a grammar stricter than the taxonomy (here: requiring exactly two letters in the optional arXiv subcategory) silently converts valid categories into empty strings, so category-only searches error out and combined searches silently drop the category and widen the search. omi-arxiv-app's _safe_category rejected physics.acc-ph, physics.optics, cond-mat.mes-hall, and cond-mat.soft, all listed in the official arXiv category taxonomy (issue #14380).
canonical_prevention: Derive the accepted grammar from the taxonomy's own form (hyphenated archive, any-length hyphenated subject class) and pin representative taxonomy identifiers in the plugin's unit suite, including a category-only query building a cat: clause and a combined query ANDing the category, so an over-narrow grammar fails CI before merge.
